## Latest News

  * 📢 [2026-06-30] Advance notice on standardized naming conventions for Ascend for PyTorch community components. 🔗 Learn more
  * 📢 [2026-04-30] TorchNPU 26.0.0 released, adding support for PyTorch 2.10.0, Python 3.13, P2P communication group dispatch, DTensor strategy extensions, and more. 🔗 Learn more

## Supported PyTorch Versions

This branch adapts to multiple PyTorch versions from a single source tree. The PyTorch versions it currently supports are declared in version.txt, which is the single source of truth and is updated as new versions are adapted.

For the compatibility matrix of released packages (TorchNPU / PyTorch / CANN / Python), please refer to Compatibility.

## Installation

### From Binary

Take installing TorchNPU 2.12.0 as an example. Run the following commands for installation. For other versions, please refer to the community download page: TorchNPU Download.

#### Install CANN

Install CANN 9.1.0 and the NPU driver and firmware matching your hardware. Use a compatible Python version from the compatibility matrix. For detailed steps, please refer to the CANN Installation Guide.

#### Install PyTorch

Run the following command to install PyTorch 2.12.0:
    
    pip install torch==2.12.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

#### Install TorchNPU

Run the following command to install TorchNPU 2.12.0:
    
    pip install torch-npu==2.12.0

### From Source

For detailed steps on compiling TorchNPU, please refer to the Source Installation Guide.

## Quick Start

### Initialize Environment
    
    # Default path, modify according to your actual installation location
    source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh

### Run Example
    
    import torch
    import torch_npu
    
    x = torch.randn(2, 2).npu()
    y = torch.randn(2, 2).npu()
    z = x.mm(y)
    print(z)

> Starting from TorchNPU 2.5.1, `import torch_npu` is no longer mandatory (auto-registration occurs), but explicit import is still recommended to ensure device initialization.
